project_context.name: CAFE DEL NORD
project_context.vibe: Modern, Minimal, Premium, Fresh, Visual-Heavy, Awwwards-style
project_context.target_emotions: Modern, Delicious, Quality, Warm, Reliable, Premium

headings.weights: Light (300) for elegance, Black (900) for kinetic impact
headings.usage: Use Cabinet Grotesk for large kinetic hero text and UI labels. Use Cormorant Garamond for manifesto, quotes, and editorial marquee.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable typography for menu items, descriptions, and standard text.

rules: Keep the interface mostly monochrome (#030303 to #FAFAFA) to let the rich, warm colors of the food photography stand out.
Never use pure black or pure white. Use the specified base and primary text colors.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, sticky navs, or dropdowns. Always use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80' to maintain readability.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass variant: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#030303]/70 with border-b border-white/10.
surfaces.cards: Subtle elevation: bg-[#0D0D0D] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl hover:border-white/15 transition-colors.

image_treatment.style: Spotlight/Clipped Frame. Wrap images in strict aspect ratios (e.g., aspect-[4/5] or aspect-square) with overflow-hidden and rounded-xl.
image_treatment.hover: Scale image on hover (scale-105) with long transition (duration-700 ease-out) while keeping the container clipped.

visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12 to p-24 for section paddings. Let the content breathe. Do NOT cramp the menu.

layouts.hero: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Kinetic typography centered or strongly left-aligned. Subtle parallax background.
layouts.menu: Sticky category sidebar (desktop) / horizontal scroll nav (mobile) alongside a single-column or two-column masonry list of dishes.
layouts.manifesto: Asymmetrical layout. Large numbers (01, 02) paired with Cormorant Garamond serif text. Massive negative space.
layouts.gallery: Bento/Masonry grid. Mix aspect ratios (tall, wide, square). No uniform squares.
layouts.mobile: Mobile-first approach. Add a fixed bottom 'Sticky Action Bar' (Menu | Search | Directions) with high z-index and glassmorphism.

EditorialMarquee.description: Slow moving, large serif text ('Cormorant Garamond') running seamlessly across the screen. Low contrast (e.g., text-white/10).

MenuSection.features: Sticky category nav, product search input.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use '@studio-freight/lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Use 'framer-motion'. Elements should fade in and slide up slightly (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) as they enter the viewport.
motion.micro_interactions: Magnetic buttons, slow image zooms on hover, subtle background color shifts.

media.strategy: Primary visual weight goes to the food. Let the images carry the warmth of the site.

local_images.instruction: Map these EXACT local filenames to the respective menu items and gallery sections.

ambient_images.description: Luxury dark cafe interior (Bar/Stools) - use for hero background or ambient parallax.
Dimly lit premium restaurant room - use for reservations or about section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over dark backgrounds maintains WCAG AA contrast. Use text-shadow if overlaying text on images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-menu-button').
accessibility.animations: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all framer-motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components in standard JSX (.js) syntax.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use Shadcn components for forms, dialogs, dropdowns.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main marketing grid and layout structures. Shadcn 'Card' is too rigid for Awwwards-style layouts.
Do not center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center } is FORBIDDEN).
Never use generic placeholder image URLs. Use the local '/images/' assets as defined in this JSON.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Apply 'data-testid' to every button, input, and interactive link.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or sticky navs. ALWAYS use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent color.
